scripts.contracts:generate: pnpm --filter backend schema && pnpm --filter web contracts
scripts.contracts:check: pnpm contracts:generate && git diff --exit-code -- contracts apps/web/generated
scripts.lint: biome check apps/web/src apps/web/vite.config.ts apps/web/playwright.config.ts apps/web/playwright.live.config.ts apps/web/e2e apps/web/live-e2e scripts && pnpm --filter backend lint
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter web test && pnpm --filter backend test:unit
